sources.calendar_note: 24 rounds and the 10 sprint weekends are official. Race order follows F1's announcement; Portugal/Spain and Austria/Britain order within their pairs is inferred. Exact race dates are not published as text, so dates are placeholders two weeks apart (only used to order races).
sources.lineup_note: status: confirmed = signed or announced; expected = reported but not officially confirmed; assumed = seat open, 2026 driver carried over as a placeholder.
